summary: A tool firmware that shows pictures sent from a web page on the FM-1's screen, for checking screen mockups on real hardware. It is not an instrument.
features: Send images from Chrome or Edge with fit, fill, stretch or 1:1 and dither
Watch a file and re-send it each time it changes
Gallery of up to 64 kept pictures in 276 KB of flash
White keys recall pictures; slideshow with 1 to 30 second pace
Reports what it shows to the FM-1 Screen Reader
